title: Research: sharp mixed UT4 root tariffs with arbitrary dirty workspace
body:
Mixtures of the six noncentral UT4 commutator targets cannot reduce their direct per-letter bill through free scalar mixing or arbitrary restored dirty workspace. This adds the uniform proof and two exact checkers under `research/ut4-mixed-root-tariffs/` only; no selected frontier or frozen source changes.

For targets `u^s_i v^t_i z^h_i`, with u=I+E13, v=I+E24, z=I+E14 and support sets S,T,H, every word in the adjacent-letter alphabet satisfies

```
n_a >= 2|S union H|,
n_b >= 2|S union T union H|,
n_c >= 2|T union H|.
```

All three bounds are attained simultaneously when no role is pure z. This includes same-role uv and central twists uz,vz,uvz. The mixture `(u,v,uv,uz,vz,uvz)` has exact bill `(10,12,10)`, or32 unit calls, for every finite restored dirty workspace. Nonnegative uniform letter tariffs are therefore sharp. The general inequalities remain necessary for pure-z roles, but sharpness is deliberately not claimed for that family.

The paid factors are `I+([g]+1)xy^T` over the **full** F2[UT4(F2)], g in {a,b,c}, all nonzero binary rank-one couplings, including nilpotents. Every undo is charged. Scalar GL mixing is favorably free; address maps, clean allocation and higher-rank unit calls are absent. The proof uses both spans of each label and exact third-order coefficients, then gives full formal attaining words separately.

**Delta and credit.** Adam Gall/PR1935, head9bb74ff3597adfe6949d7b988698b06c0c99978b, already settles disjoint u/v roles and gives a six-call same-role uv fixture. This package adds the sharp overlapping/mixed target family with central twists. It applies ToikY/PR1662's degree-three quotient and middle-span method (head01cc02b164ecc4f9d84df3f56a1fe65b88daf390) and Hanson Sun/PR1607's heterogeneous coefficient-tariff method (head9d6117918025cee6a0c5b7ef30ff8d936ca0621f). Credit steph4n-gh/PR1573, Arham Tahir/PR1589, Cinna Davis/PR1761 and the retained register-model lineage. No new rank principle or literature-priority claim.

**Validation.** Registered CPython3.12.3 full replay passes, including eight control groups. Both checkers also pass isolated optimized read-only CPython3.14.4 relocation, all14 exported files unchanged. Exact evidence: all4,096 group products, all4,913 quotient associativity triples, all20,440 two-role coefficient words through length3, and402 complete formal/faithful operators on99,264 basis columns. The independent implementation derives a rank23 relation space on40 words and uses literal group matrices and faithful regular action; it imports no primary mathematical code. There are40 omitted-call controls plus dirty-kernel, paid-rank, source/receipt and optimization controls. All12 new files reproduce byte-for-byte from the clean patch.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/ut4-mixed-root-tariffs
```

These finite checks support the fixed-group algebra lemma and written all-length/all-workspace proof; they do not extrapolate a universal theorem from a short search. The three conjugated-boundary fixtures explicitly use their conjugated restored complement, rather than claiming restoration of original coordinates.

**Scope and coordination.** One OS draw51b93dabe7190b9eb05c31682dd5750a, priority3 bit-mechanisms / bit-new-register-model; no reroll. Baseec94fd3d2fcad7ade8e72d6bcd8e223b7fdb3f30; current mainc676548106012571fefa1dce0ec16f1bcfe11dce preserves every input, instruction and selected record checked. Final overlap paginated356 open PRs and662 Discussions, no warnings, eight targeted matches all returned. Nearby heads are unchanged and claim [Discussion2019](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2019) had no replies. Search coverage is not a novelty certificate.

Mathematical/published commit `cd37822ee3523e53b645848644e0dae42d47abe7`. Primary canonical receipt `62fc9faf47d09649a98962d35922371368834e0b5452bd888f162213df7104b7`; independent receipt `407d4af5b31fd5bfebdc8cfe3e60201da5c14e662ea03a3530af2290c91eec1a`.

**No new kappa or physical supplier.** Pure-central mixed-family optimality, physical/compiler/common-label realization, hosting, precision/tape, selected cold replay and outer analytic transfer remain unproved or unrun here. Hosted CI is separate from the local checks. Open next questions identify the pure-central mixture gap and the physical invoice needed for relevance to the selected supplier.

Gareth Davidson (@bitplane), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, implementation, testing and writing; no subagents or independent human/proof-kernel review. Apache-2.0.
